gate: M12/7 Active; backend and Inspector placement slice verified
capability: Matrix Cells own optional typed placement Size and Fit/Fill/Stretch, independent of media Resolution. Natural source size is the default. Standard Inspector editing, sparse configuration, copy, persistence and history use the same Parameter nodes.

ownership.document: CellNode Size is an optional enabled/disabled Vec2 Parameter with whole-pixel 1..16384 limits; Fit Mode reuses the app-owned MediaFitMode. ConfigureCell validates first and groups value/metadata edits in one history entry. A missing address materializes one detached configured subtree.
ownership.rendering: Matrix capture retains size and fit policy with source bindings. Placement changes invalidate the projection without replacing the source epoch. The renderer shares existing media aspect policy and applies crop/quad in the existing Layer input; no extra intermediate pass. Layer logical-canvas placement retains Stretch.
ownership.contracts: Rust CellSettings generates TypeScript in the same milestone. Authored settings do not live in UI stores or opaque node data.

Includes typed Size metadata enable/disable and projection invalidation without source replacement, integer/bounds/enum rejection, atomic history, copy/save/reload, source-size changes, Fit/Fill/Stretch mappings and constant pass counts.
